body.heading: Collect and look
paragraphs: Gather fallen leaves with your adult. Look closely: some are round, some are pointy, some have wiggly edges.
Leaves are like hands: the same plan, but every one is different.

body.heading: Sort your leaves
paragraphs: Make piles by shape: round leaves here, long leaves there, star-shaped leaves in their own special pile.
Count each pile. Which shape family is the biggest in your garden?

takeaway: No two leaves are exactly alike, but their shapes make families.
safetyNotes: Only collect leaves that have already fallen; never taste leaves or berries, and wash hands afterwards.
screenFreeExtension: Trace around your favourite leaf shape and turn the outline into a picture.
